limitations.message:
Conflicting information: Inbound table repeats Device Knob1–8 at CC0x18–0x1F and Track Knob1–8 at CC0x38–0x3F, which outbound chart identifies as ring-style addresses. Do not recast as physical input. Note0x41 is both Detail View and stray Metronome(8); unlabeled CLIP STOP row retained raw.
Not included: Input CC24–31, CC56–63; Note65 Detail View/Metronome ambiguity

Conflicting information: Cue Level CC0x2F appears in absolute and relative inbound tables. Relative table defines signed delta but no authoritative correction distinguishes Cue. Excluded pending clarification.
Not included: Cue Level input CC47

Coverage limit: Generic-mode note banking/toggles are not normalized beyond definite CC banks. Introduction/inquiry and ring segment bit patterns remain complete raw evidence; dedicated adapter required.
Not included: Generic-mode note behavior; SysEx initialization/inquiry; detailed ring segment lookup

Based on archived manufacturer documentation. The complete extraction metadata, original excluded chart rows and source files are retained in the manufacturer evidence archive. No hardware testing is claimed.
